Comment: 21 CFR Part 11.50 E-Signature Workflow - Implements compliant electronic signature capture with re-authentication, signature record creation, and notification. Ensures signatures are executed by the signer at signing time (11.50) and cryptographically linked to their records (11.70).

RequestSignature.Comment: Receive and validate the signing request containing record_id, signer credentials, and signature meaning per 11.50(a)(3)

ReAuthenticate.Comment: Re-authenticate the signer at signing time per 11.50 and 11.100(a). Verifies identity via Cognito USER_PASSWORD_AUTH flow.

CheckAuthResult.Comment: Evaluate re-authentication result. If authentication failed, route to AuthFailed state per 11.50 requirement.

AuthFailed.Comment: Re-authentication failed - signature cannot be executed without verified identity per 11.50 and 11.100(a)
AuthFailed.Cause: Re-authentication failed. The signer's identity could not be verified at the time of signing as required by 21 CFR Part 11.50.

CreateSignatureRecord.Comment: Create the Part 11.50-compliant signature record with printed name (a)(1), date/time (a)(2), meaning (a)(3), and cryptographic record binding per 11.70

NotifySigner.Comment: Send SNS notification confirming signature was successfully captured with all Part 11.50 required elements

Parameters.Subject: Electronic Signature Captured - 21 CFR Part 11 Compliant

SignatureComplete.Comment: Signature workflow completed successfully. Output contains the full Part 11.50-compliant signature record with 11.70 cryptographic linking.

SignatureCreationFailed.Comment: Signature record creation failed after successful authentication
SignatureCreationFailed.Cause: Failed to create the electronic signature record in DynamoDB after successful re-authentication.
